_readMe: An example token data file. Do not change this one: copy it to a new name in this folder (for example MyService.json),
change the fields to the ones your service reads, and choose MyService.json as the event generator's Token Data File Name.
Every token gets tokenStructure.data. Token n then also gets the dataVariants entry named at position n of caseMix (wrapping round),
so each run sends the same mix. In text, ${n} becomes the token's number (1, 2, ...). Numbers and true/false stay as written.
A service mapping reads these fields as ${data.orderId}, ${data.amount}, and so on.
description: An example: an order with a number, a customer, a currency, and an amount and card that vary by the kind of order.
